prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1078; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical strain. The mechanism of injury and the force involved are, in my assessment, a good match for the symptoms reported. No prior injury to the cervical spine or upper back is known to this provider or documented in the records reviewed. Over the course of 26 visits, the patient received conservative care including manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program. Treatment ran somewhat longer than is typical for a soft tissue injury of this type, and progress was gradual. Range of motion testing showed reduced rotation and tenderness over the paraspinal muscles, which support the diagnosis. Neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Plan at discharge is continued home exercise and follow-up as needed.
